newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 54,000T S. America soy/corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 54,000T S. America soy/corn.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung Group has bought a combined shipment comprising 38,000 tonnes of soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of corn through private negotiation from U.S. grain supplier Cargill, traders said on Monday.
Word of the purchase, which was made late last week, did not circulate among Taiwan traders until Monday.
Traders said the purchase calls for the grain to be supplied from Latin American producers, but were unsure whether it specifies Brazil or Argentina, the two most likely suppliers.
The Hui Shung Group includes Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp, Eagle Food Industry and Charoen Pokphand.
The shipment was slated for late June delivery, traders said.
Further details of the shipment were not available.
